meta.title: Figma plugin · origam design system
meta.description: Sync origam design tokens and components into Figma. Install the Origam DS Sync plugin via its manifest and keep your Figma file in sync with the token layer.

hero.subtitle: Origam DS Sync is a Figma plugin that generates 14 ComponentSets bound to your design tokens, and exports them back to the repo as Tokens Studio JSON or SCSS — keeping designers and developers in perfect sync.

install.subtitle: Origam DS Sync is a development plugin — it is not published to the Figma Community. You install it locally by importing its manifest.json in Figma desktop.
install.desktop_note: Figma desktop app required — the browser version cannot load local manifests.

download.title: 1. Download the plugin
download.description: Download the zip archive containing the plugin manifest and built artefacts (dist/code.js + dist/ui.html).

unzip.title: 2. Unzip the archive
unzip.description: Extract the zip to a permanent location on your machine. Figma reads the manifest from disk — do not move the folder after importing.

menu.title: 3. Open Figma desktop → Plugins → Development
menu.description: Open any Figma file in the desktop app. In the top menu, go to Plugins → Development → Import plugin from manifest…

manifest.title: 4. Select manifest.json
manifest.description: In the file picker that opens, navigate to the unzipped folder and select manifest.json. Figma registers the plugin immediately.

run.title: 5. Run Origam DS Sync
run.description: Go to Plugins → Development → Origam DS Sync. The plugin opens with three tabs: Generate (create ComponentSets), Export (Tokens Studio JSON or SCSS), and Sync (v2 placeholder).

cta.title: Ready to sync?
cta.description: Download the plugin, explore the source, or browse the origam component catalogue to see what gets generated.
cta.actions_label: Get started with the Figma plugin
